fields.options:
An Inter Branch Sale moves stock to another group entity that keeps its own books, at a selling price. It posts the same way a Sales Invoice with stock would, but without VAT and without ZATCA: a Stock Entry (stock out at cost, debited to Cost of Goods Sold) and a Journal Entry (receivable from the customer, credited to sales income, both at the selling price).

Nothing can be submitted until every account below is set and the customer is in the list. The accounts are the client's accountant's decision.

fields.label: Receivable Account
fields.description: A Receivable account (Debtors). The customer is posted as its party, so the amount shows in that customer's statement and ageing.

fields.label: Cost of Goods Sold Account
fields.description: Expense account the Stock Entry debits with the stock's cost, as a Sales Invoice with Update Stock would.

fields.label: Sales Income Account
fields.description: Income account the Journal Entry credits with the selling price.

fields.label: Default Price List
fields.description: Selling price list read when an item has no rate typed in.

fields.label: Customers Allowed For Inter Branch Sales
fields.description: Only these customers can be used. Create each one as a normal Customer (tick Is Internal Customer) first.
